summary: This paper presents an automated algorithm for identifying paraphrased sentences in a news corpus using the Sentence-BERT model. The authors constructed a COVID-19 news dataset from CNN and Yahoo News, applying preprocessing and semantic analysis to rank sentence similarity. The system achieved a 77% precision rate, demonstrating high efficiency and performance compared to standard BERT models.
keywords: Sentence-BERT, paraphrase identification, semantic similarity, text corpus, NLP
topics: Natural Language Processing, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics
